change: Move eight immediate render flags into the actor's native state: depth test/write/write-on-fail, texture filtering/wrapping, mask source/destination, and Z-based child sorting. Live setters mutate one native bitset; state extraction skips those Lua fields. Tween steps never own these flags. Preserve recursive depth propagation, startup/model defaults, reset semantics, draw snapshot independence, definition clones and explicit state exports. Initialization uses raw flag reads without invoking authored Texture fallbacks.
baseline_method: Build the clean starting revision, then the candidate using the same pinned compiler, profile, dependencies and runner. Three serial adjacent before/after pairs per named workload, alternating order; every measurement retained.
build: Normal dev profile; song-lua/mlua opt-level 3. No test-support or song-lua-performance feature in measured binaries.

measurement.cpu_cycles: QueryThreadCycleTime on the pinned gameplay update thread.
measurement.throughput: Median headless gameplay updates/second; includes live Lua and visual publication, excludes observation hashing. This is not rendered FPS.
measurement.allocations: Rust GlobalAlloc across all threads in the measured process, including mlua. Direct native malloc is excluded. Reallocations are reported separately.
measurement.allocated_bytes: Allocation and reallocation traffic during updates, not retained memory, peak heap or RSS.
measurement.environment: Serial runs; no concurrent agent builds/tests, no GUI, GPU or audio-device initialization. Small timing differences remain noisy.

representation: Eight boolean properties share one u8 bitset plus an Option discriminant in the existing per-actor native registry. This describes the representation, not a measured heap/RSS reduction. Update-time allocation traffic is reported separately.

decision.reason: Retain native ownership of the eight immediate flags: every render-flag workload pair improved CPU and throughput, and allocation counts and byte traffic fell substantially. Other measured workloads show smaller, mixed timing changes and essentially unchanged allocations. Do not infer a universal chart speedup or a heap/RSS reduction from these samples.

timing_interpretation: Report changes of medians and adjacent-pair changes separately. Three pairs are a limited sample and small timing differences can reflect machine variation. Update-time allocation traffic and type storage size measure different things.

validation.behavior: Differential tests compare native flags to the retained Lua-field setter/reader path across active tweens, input, recursive depth propagation, multiple draws and InitState. Tests also cover independent definition/state snapshots, model defaults and promotion without extra authored __index calls. Existing focused state, tween, draw, effect and hibernation checks are retained.
validation.scope: Only the named synthetic workloads, Fof Guys/Mawaru startup windows and retained Fof Guys Single/Versus input-and-reentry captures. Fingerprints compare before/after observations; native replays verify only their captured behavior. No full fixture sweep, GUI or audio device. The normal application build is restored after test-support validation.

reference.behavior: Actor.h keeps render flags outside TweenState; setters write them immediately. ActorFrame propagates Z-test/write changes to children. Actor::InitState resets depth and texture settings; ActorFrame Z-sorting is separate. This migration preserves the existing represented behavior; no rendering rules or expected output are adjusted.
reference.changes: No ITGmania source, native capture, expected output or authored song changes.

remaining_work: Actor identity still resolves through the native replay map.
Rotation still interacts with the separate spin queue.
Other immediate properties and effect clocks still use Lua/native-vector storage.
The live scene still extracts snapshots and publishes copies to render state; direct rendering from native slots is not implemented by this change.
